## KEY POINT

Training across a wide spectrum of repetition ranges (1 to 20+) is recommended to maximize all possible avenues for the complete development of the whole muscle. However, there is some merit in focusing on a medium-repetition range (6RM to 12RM), which may provide an optimal combination of mechanical tension and metabolic stress.
